responsibility: Provides the sorted X-macro data table that maps specific quoted GCC constructs, primarily pragmas, to manual URL suffixes for documentation-link generation. It is consumed by gcc-urlifier.cc to build the hard-coded binary-searched lookup table that supplements option-table-based URLification.
same_name_distinction: This file is the data-table member of the gcc-urlifier group: unlike gcc/gcc-urlifier.cc, which implements the lookup algorithms, and gcc/gcc-urlifier.h, which declares the APIs/classes, it contains only the sorted X-macro mappings from quoted GCC constructs to documentation URL suffixes.
